Battle of Resaca.fact: Johnston asked for reinforcements, but Confederate President Jefferson Davis declined.

Battle of Resaca.fact: When Wheeler reported with near-accuracy that Sherman had 103,000 soldiers, Davis and his military adviser Braxton Bragg refused to believe it. Bragg asserted that Sherman had no more than 70,000, including a field force of 60,000.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Bragg asserted that _____ had no more than 70,000, including a field force of 60,000
Battle of Resaca.fact: When Wheeler reported with near-accuracy that Sherman had 103,000 soldiers, Davis and his military adviser Braxton Bragg refused to believe it. Bragg asserted that Sherman had no more than 70,000, including a field force of 60,000.

Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman's first task was to gather enough supplies at his Chattanooga forward base to supply 100,000 soldiers and 35,000 horses for 70 days. Sherman solved this problem by confiscating rolling stock from the Louisville and Nashville Railroad and two smaller railroads.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Davis did not trust _____, but felt that he could not replace him on the eve of the campaign
Battle of Resaca.fact: Davis did not trust Johnston, but felt that he could not replace him on the eve of the campaign.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Polk exceeded his orders by ordering French's division and _____'s cavalry to move from Mississippi to Georgia and by going there himself
Battle of Resaca.fact: Polk exceeded his orders by ordering French's division and Jackson's cavalry to move from Mississippi to Georgia and by going there himself.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By May 3, _____'s forces were in motion
Battle of Resaca.fact: Bragg asserted that Sherman had no more than 70,000, including a field force of 60,000. By May 3, Sherman's forces were in motion.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: McCook's cavalry was at _____'s Station on Sherman's left flank
Battle of Resaca.fact: McCook's cavalry was at Varnell's Station on Sherman's left flank.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Mc_____'s army marched south-southeast from Lee and Gordon Mill to Ship's Gap and then east to Villanow
Battle of Resaca.fact: McPherson's army marched south-southeast from Lee and Gordon Mill to Ship's Gap and then east to Villanow. Garrard's cavalry division was supposed to lead McPherson's columns but it was delayed; Sherman ordered the offensive to begin without it.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: On May 8, in the Battle of _____, the IV Corps brigade of Charles Garrison Harker seized the northern tip of the ridge and other units moved up to Buzzard Roost Pass
Battle of Resaca.fact: On May 8, in the Battle of Rocky Face Ridge, the IV Corps brigade of Charles Garrison Harker seized the northern tip of the ridge and other units moved up to Buzzard Roost Pass.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At Dug Gap 6 mi (_____) south, John W. Geary's XX Corps division tried to force its way through the ridge but failed
Battle of Resaca.fact: At Dug Gap 6 mi (9.7 km) south, John W. Geary's XX Corps division tried to force its way through the ridge but failed.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: However, these actions were designed to divert _____'s attention from McPherson's force
Battle of Resaca.fact: However, these actions were designed to divert Johnston's attention from McPherson's force. In fact, Wheeler's cavalry detected McPherson's column, but Johnston was convinced that it was headed for Rome.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At first, _____ ordered it to march to Dalton, but reconsidered and instructed it to stay at Resaca
Battle of Resaca.fact: However, these actions were designed to divert Johnston's attention from McPherson's force. In fact, Wheeler's cavalry detected McPherson's column, but Johnston was convinced that it was headed for Rome.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: In fact, _____'s cavalry detected McPherson's column, but Johnston was convinced that it was headed for Rome
Battle of Resaca.fact: In fact, Wheeler's cavalry detected McPherson's column, but Johnston was convinced that it was headed for Rome.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Johnston ordered that _____'s division march to Rome from Alabama and that William T. Martin's cavalry division should also go there
Battle of Resaca.fact: Johnston ordered that Loring's division march to Rome from Alabama and that William T. Martin's cavalry division should also go there.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: After a 20 mi (_____) march on May 9, the XVI Corps division of Thomas W. Sweeny passed through the 4 mi (6.4 km) long gorge of Snake Creek Gap and reached its southern exit
Battle of Resaca.fact: After a 20 mi (32.2 km) march on May 9, the XVI Corps division of Thomas W. Sweeny passed through the 4 mi (6.4 km) long gorge of Snake Creek Gap and reached its southern exit.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The other XVI Corps division of _____ and two XV Corps divisions marched as far as the northern end of the gap that evening
Battle of Resaca.fact: The other XVI Corps division of James C. Veatch and two XV Corps divisions marched as far as the northern end of the gap that evening.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The third XV Corps division was guarding the wagon train and _____'s cavalry was still distant
Battle of Resaca.fact: The third XV Corps division was guarding the wagon train and Garrard's cavalry was still distant.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Sherman directed _____ to assist McPherson by sending a cavalry brigade
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman directed Kilpatrick to assist McPherson by sending a cavalry brigade.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Mc_____ let Sherman know he was in Snake Creek Gap and issued orders to advance to Resaca the next morning
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman directed Kilpatrick to assist McPherson by sending a cavalry brigade. McPherson let Sherman know he was in Snake Creek Gap and issued orders to advance to Resaca the next morning.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Cleburne later wrote that _____'s chief of staff William W. Mackall told him that the gap was undefended because of "a flagrant disobedience to orders", but did not name the guilty party
Battle of Resaca.fact: Cleburne later wrote that Johnston's chief of staff William W. Mackall told him that the gap was undefended because of "a flagrant disobedience to orders", but did not name the guilty party. On the night of May 9, Cantey reported to Johnston that cavalry sighted Union troops near Villanow.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: On the night of May 9, _____ reported to Johnston that cavalry sighted Union troops near Villanow
Battle of Resaca.fact: On the night of May 9, Cantey reported to Johnston that cavalry sighted Union troops near Villanow.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By 2 pm, Dodge's two XVI Corps divisions reached a crossroads about 2 mi (_____) west of Resaca
Battle of Resaca.fact: By 2 pm, Dodge's two XVI Corps divisions reached a crossroads about 2 mi (3.2 km) west of Resaca.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Cantey had only 4,000 men to defend Resaca, including _____'s cavalry
Battle of Resaca.fact: Grigsby immediately ordered his cavalrymen to delay the Union advance toward Resaca. Cantey had only 4,000 men to defend Resaca, including Grigsby's cavalry.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: According to _____, the Confederate force included a brigade under Daniel H. Reynolds and two 4-gun batteries armed with 12-pounder Napoleons
Battle of Resaca.fact: According to William R. Scaife, the Confederate force included a brigade under Daniel H. Reynolds and two 4-gun batteries armed with 12-pounder Napoleons.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Another source, Cox stated that Reynolds' brigade was at _____
Battle of Resaca.fact: Another source, Cox stated that Reynolds' brigade was at Dug Gap.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences

Battle of Resaca.fact: At 4 pm, Logan's two divisions reached the crossroads, releasing Veatch's division. Veatch's men crossed Camp Creek on Sweeny's left and approached the railroad.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Veatch's men crossed _____ on Sweeny's left and approached the railroad
Battle of Resaca.fact: Veatch's men crossed Camp Creek on Sweeny's left and approached the railroad.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Meanwhile, Sweeny's division pressed forward and got within 200 yd (_____) of the railroad
Battle of Resaca.fact: Meanwhile, Sweeny's division pressed forward and got within 200 yd (183 m) of the railroad.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Mc_____, worried that he was walking into a trap, recalled both of Dodge's divisions and marched his command back to Snake Creek Gap after losing 6 killed, 30 wounded, and 16 captured
Battle of Resaca.fact: McPherson, worried that he was walking into a trap, recalled both of Dodge's divisions and marched his command back to Snake Creek Gap after losing 6 killed, 30 wounded, and 16 captured.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Johnston deployed _____'s corps on the left and Hood's corps on the right
Battle of Resaca.fact: Johnston deployed Hardee's corps on the left and Hood's corps on the right.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: When reports of Union forces at _____ reached Johnston, the Confederate commander sent the divisions of Cleburne and Walker to Tilton, north of Resaca
Battle of Resaca.fact: When reports of Union forces at Snake Creek Gap reached Johnston, the Confederate commander sent the divisions of Cleburne and Walker to Tilton, north of Resaca. On May 10, Sherman learned McPherson had failed to cut the railroad and immediately sent Hooker's XX Corps to join him at Snake Creek Gap; leaving Howard's IV Corps in front of Rocky Face Ridge, he then followed Hooker with the rest of the army.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: On May 11, Polk reached Resaca with Loring's division; next day, Palmer's and _____'s corps followed, while Johnston evacuated Dalton that night and marched his troops south to Resaca
Battle of Resaca.fact: On May 11, Polk reached Resaca with Loring's division; next day, Palmer's and Schofield's corps followed, while Johnston evacuated Dalton that night and marched his troops south to Resaca.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: On the afternoon of May 12, _____ arrived at McPherson's headquarters
Battle of Resaca.fact: On May 10, Sherman learned McPherson had failed to cut the railroad and immediately sent Hooker's XX Corps to join him at Snake Creek Gap; leaving Howard's IV Corps in front of Rocky Face Ridge, he then followed Hooker with the rest of the army. On the afternoon of May 12, Sherman arrived at McPherson's headquarters.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Later that day, _____ also arrived and informed Sherman that Johnston's wagon train was sighted moving south toward Resaca, indicating that the Confederates were probably retreating
Battle of Resaca.fact: Later that day, Thomas also arrived and informed Sherman that Johnston's wagon train was sighted moving south toward Resaca, indicating that the Confederates were probably retreating.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Sherman ordered the XIV Corps to hurry up and that formation hiked through _____ that night
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman ordered the XIV Corps to hurry up and that formation hiked through Snake Creek Gap that night.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Howard's IV Corps and _____'s cavalry division, which had finally arrived at the front, occupied Dalton on the morning of May 13
Battle of Resaca.fact: Howard's IV Corps and Stoneman's cavalry division, which had finally arrived at the front, occupied Dalton on the morning of May 13.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Howard notified _____ at 9 am that Dalton was evacuated via a temporary telegraph line strung between his headquarters and McPherson's
Battle of Resaca.fact: Later that day, Thomas also arrived and informed Sherman that Johnston's wagon train was sighted moving south toward Resaca, indicating that the Confederates were probably retreating. Sherman ordered the XIV Corps to hurry up and that formation hiked through Snake Creek Gap that night.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: In the morning, Sherman's forces advanced toward Resaca, getting within 2 mi (_____) by 10 am
Battle of Resaca.fact: In the morning, Sherman's forces advanced toward Resaca, getting within 2 mi (3.2 km) by 10 am.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Logan's XV Corps deployed with _____'s XVI Corps division on its right and elements of the XX Corps on it left and at 1 pm began pressing back Confederate skirmishers
Battle of Resaca.fact: Logan's XV Corps deployed with Veatch's XVI Corps division on its right and elements of the XX Corps on it left and at 1 pm began pressing back Confederate skirmishers. By the evening of May 13, Sherman's forces were aligned, from right to left, as follows: Veatch's division, Logan's corps, Daniel Butterfield's XX Corps division with the other two XX Corps divisions in reserve, and Palmer's XIV Corps.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By 4:30 pm, Logan's troops drove the Confederates from _____ and confronted a heavily defended line of entrenchments outside Resaca
Battle of Resaca.fact: By 4:30 pm, Logan's troops drove the Confederates from Bald Hill and confronted a heavily defended line of entrenchments outside Resaca.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Two of _____'s XXIII Corps divisions were behind XIV Corps while the third division, Alvin Peterson Hovey's, guarded Snake Creek Gap
Battle of Resaca.fact: Two of Schofield's XXIII Corps divisions were behind XIV Corps while the third division, Alvin Peterson Hovey's, guarded Snake Creek Gap.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The Union forces were confronted by the bulk of _____'s army
Battle of Resaca.fact: The Union forces were confronted by the bulk of Johnston's army. Johnston deployed Polk's corps on the Confederate left flank, facing west with its left resting on the Oostanaula.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Only the divisions of Bate, _____, and Stewart were still marching from Dalton and reached Resaca that evening
Battle of Resaca.fact: Only the divisions of Bate, Hindman, and Stewart were still marching from Dalton and reached Resaca that evening.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Johnston deployed Polk's corps on the _____ left flank, facing west with its left resting on the Oostanaula
Battle of Resaca.fact: Johnston deployed Polk's corps on the Confederate left flank, facing west with its left resting on the Oostanaula.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Hood's corps defended the right flank, facing to the north with its right touching the _____
Battle of Resaca.fact: Hood's corps defended the right flank, facing to the north with its right touching the Conasauga River.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Part of _____'s division was in reserve while the other part was at Calhoun, farther south
Battle of Resaca.fact: Part of Walker's division was in reserve while the other part was at Calhoun, farther south.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: In fact, _____ hoped Sherman would attack him and offer the chance to deal the Union army a counterblow
Battle of Resaca.fact: In fact, Johnston hoped Sherman would attack him and offer the chance to deal the Union army a counterblow. Meanwhile, Sherman wanted the Union infantry to attack so that Johnston would be unable to stop Kilpatrick and Garrard.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Sherman ordered up his _____ so that Kilpatrick's cavalry could cross the Oostanaula and damage the railroad
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman ordered up his Cumberland Pontoons so that Kilpatrick's cavalry could cross the Oostanaula and damage the railroad.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: He also wanted _____'s cavalry to cross and move toward Rome
Battle of Resaca.fact: He also wanted Garrard's cavalry to cross and move toward Rome. Meanwhile, Sherman wanted the Union infantry to attack so that Johnston would be unable to stop Kilpatrick and Garrard.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Thomas suggested sending Mc_____'s army and Hooker's corps across the Oostanaula to be in a position to interfere with a possible Confederate retreat
Battle of Resaca.fact: Thomas suggested sending McPherson's army and Hooker's corps across the Oostanaula to be in a position to interfere with a possible Confederate retreat. During the morning, at Sherman's behest, McPherson ordered Sweeny's division to cross the Oostanaula and for Garrard to march to Rome.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The pontoons arrived on the morning of May 14 and they were at Lay's Ferry on the _____ a few hours later
Battle of Resaca.fact: Thomas suggested sending McPherson's army and Hooker's corps across the Oostanaula to be in a position to interfere with a possible Confederate retreat. The pontoons arrived on the morning of May 14 and they were at Lay's Ferry on the Oostanaula a few hours later.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: During the morning, at _____'s behest, McPherson ordered Sweeny's division to cross the Oostanaula and for Garrard to march to Rome
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman rejected that idea. During the morning, at Sherman's behest, McPherson ordered Sweeny's division to cross the Oostanaula and for Garrard to march to Rome.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Sherman believed they were striking the _____ right flank
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman believed they were striking the Confederate right flank. In fact, the Union troops were unwittingly attacking the Confederate right-center.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: In fact, the Union troops were unwittingly attacking the _____ right-center
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman believed they were striking the Confederate right flank. In fact, the Union troops were unwittingly attacking the Confederate right-center.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The Union soldiers blundered through heavy underbrush and suddenly confronted _____ entrenchments on the east side of Camp Creek
Battle of Resaca.fact: Sherman believed they were striking the Confederate right flank. In fact, the Union troops were unwittingly attacking the Confederate right-center.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By 3 pm, _____'s division lost 700 killed or wounded while Cox's troops sustained losses of 66 killed and 486 wounded
Battle of Resaca.fact: Henry M. Judah's XXIII Corps division recklessly charged, ran into intense rifle and cannon fire, and was bloodily repulsed. On Judah's left, Cox's XXIII Corps division encountered an advanced line of rifle pits and seized them after a bitter struggle.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Subsequently, Union artillery unlimbered and took the _____ lines under a withering bombardment
Battle of Resaca.fact: Subsequently, Union artillery unlimbered and took the Confederate lines under a withering bombardment.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 4 pm, _____ noticed that David S. Stanley's division of Howard's corps had its left flank exposed and ordered Hood to attack it
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 4 pm, Johnston noticed that David S. Stanley's division of Howard's corps had its left flank exposed and ordered Hood to attack it.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 5 pm, the divisions of _____ and Stevenson advanced, supported by three brigades from Walker's division and one brigade from Loring's division
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 5 pm, the divisions of Stewart and Stevenson advanced, supported by three brigades from Walker's division and one brigade from Loring's division.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Stanley called for help, formed his division into a long thin line, and posted _____'s 5th Indiana Battery on the extreme left flank
Battle of Resaca.fact: Stanley called for help, formed his division into a long thin line, and posted Peter Simonson's 5th Indiana Battery on the extreme left flank.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Howard asked for reinforcements and the division of _____ from Hooker's corps was sent
Battle of Resaca.fact: Howard asked for reinforcements and the division of Alpheus S. Williams from Hooker's corps was sent.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By the time the _____ attempted a third attack, Williams' division arrived and repelled it with heavy losses
Battle of Resaca.fact: By the time the Confederates attempted a third attack, Williams' division arrived and repelled it with heavy losses.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: During the afternoon, _____ detected weakness in the Confederate skirmish line and pushed the 12th Missouri Infantry forward
Battle of Resaca.fact: During the afternoon, Peter Joseph Osterhaus detected weakness in the Confederate skirmish line and pushed the 12th Missouri Infantry forward.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: The regiment captured the bridge over _____ and entrenched a position protecting the span
Battle of Resaca.fact: The regiment captured the bridge over Camp Creek and entrenched a position protecting the span. Determined to stop the transfer of more troops, he ordered two XV Corps brigades to seize a hill on the other side of Camp Creek.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Determined to stop the transfer of more troops, he ordered two XV Corps brigades to seize a hill on the other side of _____
Battle of Resaca.fact: The regiment captured the bridge over Camp Creek and entrenched a position protecting the span. Determined to stop the transfer of more troops, he ordered two XV Corps brigades to seize a hill on the other side of Camp Creek.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 5 pm, Mc_____ became aware that the Confederates opposing him were sending troops to the north
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 5 pm, McPherson became aware that the Confederates opposing him were sending troops to the north.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 7:30 pm, Cantey's division and _____.'s brigade tried three times to retake the hill, but failed in the face of cannon projectiles from Louis Voelker's Battery F, 2nd Missouri and rifle fire
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 7:30 pm, Cantey's division and Alfred Jefferson Vaughan Jr.'s brigade tried three times to retake the hill, but failed in the face of cannon projectiles from Louis Voelker's Battery F, 2nd Missouri and rifle fire.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Because artillery placed on the hill could hit the railroad and wagon bridges, _____ ordered a pontoon bridge to be placed out of cannon range
Battle of Resaca.fact: Because artillery placed on the hill could hit the railroad and wagon bridges, Johnston ordered a pontoon bridge to be placed out of cannon range.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: However, after receiving a report that _____ were building a bridge upstream, Sweeny withdrew from his bridgehead
Battle of Resaca.fact: However, after receiving a report that Confederates were building a bridge upstream, Sweeny withdrew from his bridgehead.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Mc_____ was directed to hold his ground in the expectation that he would be attacked
Battle of Resaca.fact: McPherson was directed to hold his ground in the expectation that he would be attacked.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Johnston originally planned to attack the Federal left flank again, but canceled that plan when he heard that Union forces had bridged the _____ and gained a foothold in Polk's defenses
Battle of Resaca.fact: Johnston originally planned to attack the Federal left flank again, but canceled that plan when he heard that Union forces had bridged the Oostanaula and gained a foothold in Polk's defenses.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: During the morning, the only action occurred when some of _____'s cavalry crossed the Conasauga and overran a Confederate hospital before being chased away
Battle of Resaca.fact: During the morning, the only action occurred when some of Stoneman's cavalry crossed the Conasauga and overran a Confederate hospital before being chased away.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 1 pm, _____ launched his attack and it was immediately repulsed by intense rifle and cannon fire
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 1 pm, Howard launched his attack and it was immediately repulsed by intense rifle and cannon fire. To Howard's left, Hooker attacked with Geary's and Butterfield's divisions, about 12,000 men, at 1:30 pm.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Union brigade commander _____ was seriously wounded in the subsequent exchange of rifle fire
Battle of Resaca.fact: Union brigade commander August Willich was seriously wounded in the subsequent exchange of rifle fire.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: However, _____'s brigade, led by Benjamin Harrison's 70th Indiana Infantry Regiment, found itself in front of Max Van Den Corput's Georgia Cherokee Battery and charged, overrunning the guns
Battle of Resaca.fact: However, William Thomas Ward's brigade, led by Benjamin Harrison's 70th Indiana Infantry Regiment, found itself in front of Max Van Den Corput's Georgia Cherokee Battery and charged, overrunning the guns.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Confederate counterattacks drove back Ward's men, but _____'s brigade retook the guns before also being driven back
Battle of Resaca.fact: Confederate counterattacks drove back Ward's men, but John Coburn's brigade retook the guns before also being driven back.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Finally, the four 12-pounder _____ were left in no man's land, with neither side able to claim the guns
Battle of Resaca.fact: Finally, the four 12-pounder Napoleons were left in no man's land, with neither side able to claim the guns.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: After Johnston heard that the _____ were no longer a threat at Lay's Ferry, he ordered Hood to attack the Union left flank again
Battle of Resaca.fact: After Johnston heard that the Federals were no longer a threat at Lay's Ferry, he ordered Hood to attack the Union left flank again. Soon after, Walker reported that the Federals were across the Oostanaula at Lay's Ferry again.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: At 4 pm, _____'s division launched its attack as per Hood's instructions
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 4 pm, Stewart's division launched its attack as per Hood's instructions. By happenstance, Stewart's brigades emerged from the forest one at a time and were badly mauled by Williams' division.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: By happenstance, _____'s brigades emerged from the forest one at a time and were badly mauled by Williams' division
Battle of Resaca.fact: At 4 pm, Stewart's division launched its attack as per Hood's instructions. By happenstance, Stewart's brigades emerged from the forest one at a time and were badly mauled by Williams' division.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Soon after, _____ reported that the Federals were across the Oostanaula at Lay's Ferry again
Battle of Resaca.fact: Soon after, Walker reported that the Federals were across the Oostanaula at Lay's Ferry again.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Hovey's XXIII Corps division, formed of recruits, was supposed to support _____, but instead its soldiers hugged the ground and refused to go forward
Battle of Resaca.fact: By happenstance, Stewart's brigades emerged from the forest one at a time and were badly mauled by Williams' division. Williams' troops lost 48 killed and 366 wounded while inflicting 1,000 casualties on Stewart's division.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: Meanwhile, at Lay's Ferry, _____ learned that the Confederate bridge was a false report
Battle of Resaca.fact: Meanwhile, at Lay's Ferry, Sweeny learned that the Confederate bridge was a false report.

Battle of Resaca.subject: Applied Sciences
Battle of Resaca.question: That evening, after meeting with Hood and Hardee, _____ ordered his army to retreat from Resaca

Biomaterial.subject: Applied Sciences
Biomaterial.question: The _____ was Substance engineered for biological medical use.
Biomaterial.fact: A biomaterial is a substance that has been engineered to interact with biological systems for a medical purpose – either a therapeutic (treat, augment, repair, or replace a tissue function of the body) or a diagnostic one. Biomechanics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biomechanics.question: The _____ was Study of the mechanics of biological systems.
Biomechanics.fact: Biomechanics is the study of the structure, function and motion of the mechanical aspects of biological systems using the methods of mechanics. Biomechanics is a branch of biophysics.

Biomechatronics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biomechatronics.question: The _____ was Interdisciplinary science integrating biology and mechatronics.
Biomechatronics.fact: Bio-mechatronics is an applied interdisciplinary science that aims to integrate biology and mechatronics (electrical, electronics, and mechanical engineering). It also encompasses the fields of robotics and neuroscience.

Biophysics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biophysics.question: The _____ was Interdisciplinary science.
Biophysics.fact: Biophysics is an interdisciplinary science that applies approaches and methods traditionally used in physics to study biological phenomena. Biophysics covers all scales of biological organization, from molecular to organismic and populations.
